author: mongo-portal maintainers
tooling: manual analysis; enforced by the CI dependency gate

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages are unmaintained, unsafe by design, and have known security issues.

statements.impact_statement: The advisory concerns only the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages. They are not compiled into the mongo-portal binary: `go list -deps ./cmd/portal` lists only x/crypto/pbkdf2, x/crypto/scrypt and x/crypto/ocsp (required by the MongoDB driver and pkcs8), and govulncheck symbol analysis reports no reachable use. CI fails the build if any openpgp package becomes a dependency of the binary. Review again by 2027-01-22 or when x/crypto changes.
statements.action_statement: None required while the CI dependency gate passes.
